# Maple Design Mobile

> Vue 3 component library. Package: @maple-design/ui-vue. Component prefix: Mp / mp-.

Read the quick start and the relevant component page before generating code. Follow the documented props, events, slots, imports and styles. Do not substitute APIs from another component library.

Links are relative to this file and work under a documentation deployment subpath. English pages are included only when an authored English source exists.

- [Full documentation](./llms-full.txt): All pages and expanded Vue examples; large context required.
